[GENERATED IMPLEMENTATION]
import tactic

def implementation (n: Nat) : List Nat :=
  let rec collatz_odd_seq (n: Nat) (seq: List Nat) : List Nat :=
    if n = 1 then seq else
    if n % 2 = 0 then
      collatz_odd_seq (n / 2) (seq ++ [n])
    else
      collatz_odd_seq (3 * n + 1) (seq ++ [n])
  collatz_odd_seq n []

[HELPER LEMMAS]
lemma collatz_odd_seq_correct
(n: Nat)
(seq: List Nat)
: collatz_odd_seq n seq = seq ++ [n] ∨
  collatz_odd_seq n seq = seq ++ [n / 2] ∨
  collatz_odd_seq n seq = seq ++ [(3 * n + 1)] :=
by
induction n generalizing seq
